articles.title_en: Rethinking land readjustment: Fit-for-purpose rules for joint use in real estate development
articles.title_cn: 重新思考土地重划：房地产开发中联合使用的适用性规则
articles.abstract_en: Urban development frequently requires land assembly, cross-parcel coordination, and allocation of costs and benefits created by zoning plans. In Norway, property-formation tasks typically rely on cadastral procedures that depend on voluntary agreement and may involve multiple fragmented, sequential, and time-consuming approvals. This article examines whether organizational instruments under the Land Consolidation Act – rules on joint use, orders for joint measures, and governance arrangements – can function as a less invasive and more efficient complement to physical reallotment in urban land readjustment. Using a structured review of Norwegian zoning plans and Land Consolidation Court decisions, supplemented with targeted literature, we identify (i) coordination problems these instruments can address, (ii) their legal effects and constraints, and (iii) practical conditions for implementation, including loss-prevention rules and transition to later physical property formation. We conclude that organizational instruments are best suited for early-phase cooperation and shared functions (e.g., access, infrastructure, common areas), reducing transaction costs and holdout risks when physical reallotment is premature. We discuss implications for ‘fit-for-purpose’ land readjustment and outline how comparable rule-based joint-use solutions may be adapted to resource-constrained contexts, provided that legal clarity and registration mechanisms are addressed. In Norwegian land consolidation law traditional physical readjustment includes measures such as land exchange and the reduction of fragmentation of holdings. Organizational instruments, by contrast, operate closer to the actual coordination problems faced in urban development. As such, they represent a more fit-for-purpose response to the challenges of fragmented ownership and cross-boundary planning in transformation areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市开发经常需要土地归整、跨地块协调以及分区规划所产生的成本与收益分配。在挪威，产权形成任务通常依赖地籍程序，这些程序取决于自愿协议，并可能涉及多个碎片化、顺序进行且耗时的审批。本文考察《土地整理法》下的组织性工具——关于联合使用的规则、联合措施命令以及治理安排——能否在城镇土地重划中作为物理重新分配的一种侵入性更小且更高效的补充。通过对挪威分区规划和土地整理法院裁决的结构化审查，并辅以有针对性的文献，我们识别出（i）这些工具能够解决的协调问题，（ii）其法律效力与约束，以及（iii）实施的实际条件，包括损失预防规则和向后续物理产权形成的过渡。我们得出结论：组织性工具最适合早期阶段合作和共享功能（例如通行、基础设施、公共区域），在物理重新分配尚不成熟时降低交易成本和抵制风险。我们讨论了对“适用性”土地重划的启示，并概述了基于规则的类似联合使用解决方案如何在资源受限情境中加以调整，前提是法律清晰性和登记机制得到解决。在挪威土地整理法中，传统的物理重新分配包括土地交换和减少地块碎片化等措施。相比之下，组织性工具更贴近城市开发中实际面临的协调问题。因此，它们是对转型区域中碎片化所有权和跨边界规划挑战的一种更具适用性的回应。

articles.title_en: Joint production, externalities, and terrace conservation strategies
articles.title_cn: 联合生产、外部性与梯田保护策略
articles.abstract_en: Multifunctional agriculture jointly produces commodity and non-commodity outputs, yet many non-commodity benefits are underprovided due to insufficient economic incentives. This challenge is amplified in the agriculture-tourism nexus, where tourism depends on agricultural landscapes while potentially contributing to their degradation, creating interconnected externalities that distort benefit distribution and undermine joint production efficiency. This study extends joint production theory to the agriculture-tourism nexus by developing a framework for integrated terraced agriculture-ecotourism production, in which tourism generates conservation incentives by capturing economic value from landscape and environmental services. We identify the socially optimal provision of agricultural non-commodity benefits under different landscape loss scenarios and examine how externality internalization and multi-stakeholder collaboration affect joint production efficiency. The results show that achieving optimal multifunctionality requires balancing the benefits and costs of externality internalization across agricultural and tourism activities. Failure to do so may reduce joint production efficiency by distorting factor income distribution. Multi-stakeholder collaboration improves benefit allocation and lowers internalization costs, enabling the socially optimal provision of agricultural non-commodity benefits. These findings underscore the need for integrated governance mechanisms that align economic incentives with ecological conservation in mountainous regions.
articles.abstract_cn: 多功能农业联合生产商品和非商品产出，但由于经济激励不足，许多非商品收益供给不足。这一挑战在农业—旅游关联中被放大，其中旅游依赖农业景观，同时可能促使其退化，形成相互关联的外部性，扭曲收益分配并削弱联合生产效率。本研究通过构建梯田农业—生态旅游一体化生产框架，将联合生产理论拓展至农业—旅游关联，其中旅游通过获取景观和环境服务的经济价值产生保护激励。我们识别不同景观损失情景下农业非商品收益的社会最优供给，并考察外部性内部化和多利益相关者协作如何影响联合生产效率。结果表明，实现最优多功能性需要在农业和旅游活动之间平衡外部性内部化的收益与成本。未能如此可能通过扭曲要素收入分配而降低联合生产效率。多利益相关者协作改善收益分配并降低内部化成本，从而实现农业非商品收益的社会最优供给。这些发现凸显了在山区将经济激励与生态保护相协调的综合治理机制的必要性。

articles.title_en: From planar proximity to room-level depth: Nonlinear capitalization of historic landscape visibility in dense urban districts
articles.title_cn: 从平面邻近到房间级深度：密集城区历史景观可见性的非线性资本化
articles.abstract_en: Historic landscapes are frequently capitalized into accommodation prices, yet existing valuation frameworks still rely heavily on planar proximity or coarse visibility proxies that fail to capture room-level three-dimensional exposure in dense urban settings. This study develops an automated multi scalar analytical framework that integrates room level three dimensional viewshed modelling, street-view image perception, semantic segmentation, and explainable machine learning to estimate how multidimensional visual exposure translates into hotel room premiums in Beijing’s historic core. The analysis yields four main findings. First, three-dimensional exposure variables, especially maximum visual depth, provide substantially greater explanatory power than conventional visible-area measures, showing that being spatially close is not equivalent to seeing deeply. Second, room premiums respond to visual environments through nonlinear thresholds rather than smooth linear increments: moderate vertical observation conditions and moderate visual complexity are associated with stronger capitalization, whereas excessive visual competition from surrounding buildings rapidly erodes marginal returns. Third, landmark visual connectivity corresponds to discrete rent surges once critical visibility levels are reached, indicating that iconic heritage nodes reflect threshold like spillover effects on nearby accommodation prices. Fourth, both the magnitude and internal structure of visual premiums vary sharply across districts, demonstrating that capitalization is spatially differentiated rather than spatially uniform within the historic core. By shifting valuation from planar proximity to room-level depth, this study advances three-dimensional visibility assessment and provides an operational framework for view-corridor protection, height control, and differentiated heritage-area management in high-density historic environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 历史景观常被资本化到住宿价格中，但现有估值框架仍严重依赖平面邻近性或粗糙的可见性代理变量，无法捕捉密集城市环境中的房间级三维暴露。本研究开发了一个自动化多尺度分析框架，整合房间级三维视域建模、街景图像感知、语义分割和可解释机器学习，以估计多维视觉暴露如何转化为北京历史核心区酒店房间溢价。分析得出四个主要发现。第一，三维暴露变量，尤其是最大视觉深度，比传统可见面积指标提供了 substantially 更强的解释力，表明空间上接近并不等同于看得深。第二，房间溢价通过非线性阈值而非平滑线性增量对视觉环境作出反应：适度的垂直观察条件和适度的视觉复杂度与更强的资本化相关联，而来自周围建筑的过度视觉竞争会迅速侵蚀边际回报。第三，地标视觉连通性在达到关键可见性水平后对应离散的租金跃升，表明标志性遗产节点对附近住宿价格反映阈值式溢出效应。第四，视觉溢价的大小和内部结构在不同区域间差异显著，表明历史核心区内的资本化是空间分化的而非空间均质的。通过将估值从平面邻近转向房间级深度，本研究推进了三维可见性评估，并为高密度历史环境中的视廊保护、高度控制和差异化遗产区管理提供了可操作框架。

articles.title_en: Alleviating urban heat exposure through green space optimization: A multi-objective framework using cellular signaling data
articles.title_cn: 通过绿地优化缓解城市热暴露：使用蜂窝信令数据的多目标框架
articles.abstract_en: Extreme heat events significantly threaten public health and urban sustainability. Traditional urban green space (UGS) optimization often relies on static census data, failing to capture spatio-temporal variations in human activity and associated thermal risks. This study proposes a spatially explicit multi-objective optimization model to mitigate heat exposure in Xuzhou’s central urban area. Integrating hourly cellular signaling data from three representative time points (08:00, 14:00, and 20:00), the optimization framework utilizes a heuristic search strategy to simultaneously optimize four critical objectives: reducing heat exposure, minimizing conversion cost, enhancing spatial equity, and improving morphological compactness. Three policy-oriented scenarios—balanced development (BD), cost-effective (CE), and social equity (SE)—were simulated to explore the trade-offs between fiscal constraints and climate benefits. The main findings are as follows: (1) The proposed framework effectively captures the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of population heat exposure and generates differentiated UGS layouts under varying policy priorities. (2) The CE scenario achieves the lowest conversion cost, whereas the SE scenario yields higher cooling effectiveness and lower Gini coefficients through dispersed micro-scale green interventions in densely populated areas; the BD scenario provides a balanced compromise among the four objectives. (3) Spatial overlay analysis further identifies no-regret intervention zones that remain stable across scenarios and time periods, which are mainly concentrated on public service land, warehousing land, rural homesteads, and vacant land. This study advances UGS optimization from static, land-oriented planning toward multi-temporal, people-centered climate adaptation, providing practical support for heat mitigation and resilient urban planning in high-density cities.
articles.abstract_cn: 极端高温事件显著威胁公共健康和城市可持续性。传统城市绿地（UGS）优化往往依赖静态普查数据，无法捕捉人类活动的时空变化及相关热风险。本研究提出一个空间显式的多目标优化模型，以缓解徐州中心城区的热暴露。整合来自三个代表性时间点（08:00、14:00和20:00）的逐小时蜂窝信令数据，该优化框架采用启发式搜索策略，同时优化四个关键目标：降低热暴露、最小化转换成本、增强空间公平性和改善形态紧凑性。模拟了三种政策导向情景——均衡发展（BD）、成本有效（CE）和社会公平（SE）——以探索财政约束与气候效益之间的权衡。主要发现如下：（1）所提框架有效捕捉了人口热暴露的时空异质性，并在不同政策优先级下生成差异化的UGS布局。（2）CE情景实现最低转换成本，而SE情景通过在人口密集地区分散的微型绿色干预产生更高的降温效果和更低的基尼系数；BD情景在四个目标之间提供均衡折衷。（3）空间叠加分析进一步识别出在不同情景和时间段保持稳定的无悔干预区，这些区域主要集中在公共服务用地、仓储用地、农村宅基地和空闲地上。本研究将UGS优化从静态的、以土地为导向的规划推进到多时相、以人为本的气候适应，为高密度城市的热缓解和韧性城市规划提供实践支持。

articles.title_en: Land price stabilization under Japan's LocatIon Optimization Plan: A propensity score matching analysis of Hachioji City
articles.title_cn: 日本区位优化计划下的地价稳定：八王子市倾向得分匹配分析
articles.abstract_en: This study uses propensity score matching (PSM) to quantitatively evaluate the impact of Japan's Location Optimization Plan (LOP) on residential land prices. Despite the growing attention given to compact city development policies, rigorous empirical evaluations of the effectiveness of the LOP using causal inference methods remain limited. Stable land prices are crucial for sustainable urban development. Stable land prices ensure fair property valuations and promote investment confidence. Land price stability also affects infrastructure planning. The analysis uses data from Hachioji City, where the LOP has been implemented for over a decade, and compares it with data from other densely populated areas within Tokyo Prefecture. By applying nearest neighbor and kernel matching techniques, the study isolates the effects of the policy from confounding variables. The results demonstrate that land prices in Hachioji City decreased by approximately 6701.32 JPY/m2 compared to other areas in Tokyo. The results suggest that LOP implementation is associated with more moderate land price changes in Hachioji than in comparable areas. The findings contribute to our understanding of how spatial planning policies influence land markets in the context of demographic decline. The findings also offer methodological foundations for future policy assessments in similar contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究使用倾向得分匹配（PSM）定量评估日本区位优化计划（LOP）对住宅地价的影响。尽管紧凑型城市发展政策日益受到关注，但使用因果推断方法对LOP有效性的严格实证评估仍然有限。稳定的地价对可持续城市发展至关重要。稳定的地价确保公平的财产估值并促进投资信心。地价稳定还影响基础设施规划。分析使用已实施LOP超过十年的八王子市数据，并与东京都内其他人口密集地区的数据进行比较。通过应用最近邻和核匹配技术，本研究将政策效应与混杂变量分离。结果表明，与其他东京地区相比，八王子市的地价下降了约6701.32日元/m2。结果表明，与可比地区相比，LOP的实施与八王子市更温和的地价变化相关。研究结果有助于我们理解空间规划政策在人口下降背景下如何影响土地市场。研究结果也为类似背景下未来的政策评估提供了方法论基础。

articles.title_en: The biodiversity impacts of forestry and agricultural land grabs on Indigenous Peoples’ Lands
articles.title_cn: 林业和农业土地掠夺对原住民土地生物多样性的影响
articles.abstract_en: Indigenous Peoples' Lands (IPLs) play a key role in biodiversity conservation, yet IPLs are vulnerable to land grabbing for agricultural development. To understand the potential habitat exposure and main commodities overlapping with land grabs on IPLs, we combined the spatial distribution of land grabs intended for agricultural crops, plantations, and logging on IPLs with biodiversity metrics for mammal and bird species. Globally, 9.4 Mha of land grabs were on IPLs, with Russia (4.5 Mha), Myanmar (0.7 Mha), and Indonesia (0.7 Mha) having the highest areas. Land grabs were mainly for logging in Russia, biofuels in Myanmar, and a mixture of non-food, food, and biofuel crops in Indonesia. Oil palm (39 kha) and rice (37 kha) were the food crops and oil palm (42 kha) the biofuel crop associated with the highest deforestation areas on grabbed IPLs, while it was rubber (6 kha) for non-food crops. Deforestation on grabbed IPLs overlapped with 3213 species ranges with the highest potential habitat exposure in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Vietnam, on land grabs intended for oil palm, rubber crops, and timber plantations. Our results show that there are substantial land grabs on IPLs with a considerable potential habitat exposure, hence more effort is needed to protect IPL rights, ensuring indigenous stewardship of their land and biodiversity conservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 原住民土地（IPLs）在生物多样性保护中发挥关键作用，但IPLs易受农业开发土地掠夺的影响。为了解IPLs上土地掠夺的潜在栖息地暴露及主要重叠商品，我们将IPLs上用于农作物、种植园和伐木的土地掠夺空间分布与哺乳动物和鸟类物种的生物多样性指标相结合。全球范围内，9.4 Mha的土地掠夺发生在IPLs上，其中俄罗斯（4.5 Mha）、缅甸（0.7 Mha）和印度尼西亚（0.7 Mha）面积最大。土地掠夺在俄罗斯主要用于伐木，在缅甸用于生物燃料，在印度尼西亚则混合了非粮食、粮食和生物燃料作物。在被掠夺的IPLs上，与最高森林砍伐面积相关的粮食作物是油棕（39 kha）和水稻（37 kha），生物燃料作物是油棕（42 kha），而非粮食作物则是橡胶（6 kha）。被掠夺IPLs上的森林砍伐与3213个物种的分布范围重叠，在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和越南，针对油棕、橡胶作物和木材种植园的土地掠夺中潜在栖息地暴露最高。我们的结果表明，IPLs上存在大量土地掠夺，并具有相当大的潜在栖息地暴露，因此需要更多努力来保护IPL权利，确保原住民对其土地的管理和生物多样性保护。

articles.title_en: Explaining urban density trends; a global assessment of the factors that steer changes in urban population density
articles.title_cn: 解释城市密度趋势；对引导城市人口密度变化的因素的全球评估
articles.abstract_en: Urban expansion is strongly determined by changes in urban population and the density in which new residents settle. Consequently, assessments of future changes in urban area depend on population and density projections. While the former are well-established, the latter have received much less research attention. To fill this void, we set up a time series representing most countries around the globe describing urban population density and several explanatory variables. Using a panel regression approach with country-fixed effects we explain the variation in density levels over time. The results indicate that urban density increases with growing total urban population and decreases with increasing levels of urbanisation. The latter effect diminishes, however, when the urban population fraction increases even further. These results indicate a sequence of increasing, decreasing and stabilising urban densities with increasing urban population shares. This succession can be linked to subsequent development stages of urbanisation, suburbanisation and eventually reurbanisation. The latter stage remains rare in our time series, however, as only a few countries reach the corresponding high urbanisation rates. Furthermore, we find that urban densities decrease with growing national income per capita. This may indicate that higher incomes enable suburbanisation to more dispersed urban areas with larger residences but can also be associated with the advent of smaller households and the growth of non-residential sectors such as industry and commerce. Conversely, urban density increases with higher agricultural land values that we proxy with a novel primary production intensity variable. We use our explanatory results to determine country-specific future urban areas following a commonly applied socio-economic scenario (SSP2) and suggest the total global urban area may triple from 2015 to 2100.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市扩张在很大程度上由城市人口变化以及新居民定居的密度决定。因此，对未来城市区域变化的评估取决于人口和密度预测。前者已较为成熟，后者则受到的研究关注少得多。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个涵盖全球大多数国家的时间序列，描述城市人口密度及若干解释变量。采用带有国家固定效应的面板回归方法，我们解释了密度水平随时间的变化。结果表明，城市密度随城市总人口增长而上升，随城市化水平提高而下降。然而，当城市人口比重进一步提高时，后一效应会减弱。这些结果表明，随着城市人口比重上升，城市密度呈现先上升、后下降、再稳定的序列。这一序列可与城市化、郊区化乃至最终再城市化的后续发展阶段相联系。然而，后一阶段在我们的时间序列中仍然罕见，因为只有少数国家达到相应的高城市化率。此外，我们发现城市密度随人均国民收入增长而下降。这可能表明，更高的收入使郊区化得以扩展到更分散、住宅更大的城市区域，但也可能与更小家庭的出现以及工业和商业等非住宅部门的增长相关。相反，城市密度随农业土地价值升高而上升，我们用一个新的初级生产强度变量作为其代理。我们利用解释性结果，按照一个常用的社会经济情景（SSP2）确定各国未来的城市区域，并表明全球城市总面积可能从2015增至2100，增长两倍。

articles.title_en: Beyond the tragedy of the commons: Spiritual legitimacy, customary land governance, and community development in Northern Ghana
articles.title_cn: 超越公地悲剧：加纳北部的精神合法性、习惯法土地治理与社区发展
articles.abstract_en: Customary land governance is widely studied in Northern Ghana for its failures, yet its contributions to social cohesion, community development, and resource management are underexplored. This study bridges that gap using a qualitative case of the Bole Traditional Area in the Savannah Region of Ghana, where customary land governance remains active and legitimate despite pressures from land commercialisation, small-scale mining and urbanisation. Drawing on twenty key informant interviews (KII) with land custodians (tindanas), chiefs, and community members, with eight focus group discussions, two each across the four communities (Kalba, Gbeniyiri, Soma, and Datompilayiri). The study employed thematic data analysis to examine how traditional values shape land governance, conflict resolution, environmental stewardship, and access equity. This study builds on Ostrom’s Common Pool Resource Theory, expanding it by showing how spiritual legitimacy is central and not periphery to effective customary governance, a dimension historically neglected by the framework. The study reveals that, land spiritual framing makes conflict resolution a moral process that sustains compliance beyond coercion, it also revealed that, indigenous conservation practices function as adaptive resource management strategies underrecognised by statutory frameworks, also gendered and generational hierarchies persistently constrain women and youth land access, with reforms failing to dismantle underlying inequalities. The study suggests a hybrid governance framework that honours indigenous strategies while addressing exclusion.
articles.abstract_cn: 习惯法土地治理因其失败而在加纳北部被广泛研究，但其对社会凝聚力、社区发展和资源管理的贡献却探讨不足。本研究通过加纳萨凡纳地区博莱传统区的定性案例填补这一空白，该地区的习惯法土地治理尽管面临土地商业化、小规模采矿和城市化的压力，仍然活跃且具有合法性。研究基于对土地保管人（tindanas）、酋长和社区成员进行的二十次关键知情人访谈（KII），以及八次焦点小组讨论，四个社区（Kalba、Gbeniyiri、Soma和Datompilayiri）各两次。研究采用主题数据分析，考察传统价值观如何塑造土地治理、冲突解决、环境管理和获取公平。本研究建立在Ostrom的公共池塘资源理论之上，通过表明精神合法性对有效的习惯法治理是核心而非边缘的，从而扩展了该理论，而这一维度在历史上被该框架所忽视。研究揭示，土地的精神框架使冲突解决成为一个道德过程，从而在强制之外维持遵从；研究还揭示，本土保护实践作为适应性资源管理策略发挥作用，但被成文法框架所低估；此外，性别和代际等级制度持续制约妇女和青年的土地获取，改革未能消除 underlying 不平等。研究建议建立一个混合治理框架，既尊重本土策略，又解决排斥问题。

articles.title_en: Legal pluralism and coastal land access: Inequalities, governance, and tourism pressure in Mahajanga
articles.title_cn: 法律多元主义与沿海土地获取：马哈赞加的不平等、治理与旅游压力
articles.abstract_en: This article examines unequal access to coastal land in Mahajanga, Madagascar, under legal pluralism and growing tourism pressure. It analyses the gap between state land law, customary tenure practices and effective control over coastal space. The study uses a mixed-methods single-case design. Primary data come from 300 participants: 180 completed structured questionnaires and 120 took part in semi-structured interviews. Additional primary evidence includes observations across 16 sites, georeferenced records, field photographs and 100 locally collected taratasy, or informal land deeds. Secondary data include 47 land registration files, legal texts, cadastral records, census data and satellite imagery. Formal tenure security rarely matches widespread customary occupation. Among the 200 local household and resident participants, 72.0% relied mainly on customary arrangements, while only 15.0% held a registered land title. Coastal sectors with greater tourism development also show higher land values, a stronger concentration of formal transactions near the shoreline and more conflicts over access, enclosure and territorial control. Formal registration remains easier for actors with greater financial resources and stronger administrative networks. Within the Amborovy coastal sector, particularly in Marohala, Petite Plage and Grand Pavois, fences and tourism facilities restrict public access to the shore and reduce spaces used by fishing households. Existing land management tools therefore give limited protection to long-established occupants during rapid market change. The findings support closer coordination between land administration, local land uses and public coastal access. The case extends debates on legal pluralism and tourism-led land restructuring to secondary coastal cities in the Global South.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察马达加斯加马哈赞加在法律多元主义和日益增长的旅游压力下沿海土地获取不平等的问题。文章分析了国家土地法、习惯性权属实践与对沿海空间的实际控制之间的差距。本研究采用混合方法单案例设计。主要数据来自300名参与者：180人完成了结构化问卷，120人参与了半结构化访谈。其他主要证据包括对16个地点的观察、地理参照记录、实地照片以及当地收集的100份taratasy（非正式土地契约）。次要数据包括47份土地登记档案、法律文本、地籍记录、普查数据和卫星影像。正式权属保障很少与普遍的习惯性占用相匹配。在200名当地家庭和居民参与者中，72.0%人主要依赖习惯性安排，而仅有15.0%人持有登记土地权属证书。旅游开发程度较高的沿海地段也表现出更高的土地价值、formal transactions在海岸线附近更强的集中，以及围绕获取、圈占和领土控制的更多冲突。正式登记对于拥有更多财政资源和更强行政网络的行为者而言仍然更容易。在Amborovy沿海地段，特别是在Marohala、Petite Plage和Grand Pavois，围栏和旅游设施限制了公众对海岸的获取，并减少了捕鱼家庭使用的空间。因此，现有土地管理工具在快速市场变化期间对长期既有占用者提供的保护有限。研究结果支持土地管理、当地土地利用与公共沿海获取之间更紧密的协调。该案例将关于法律多元主义和旅游主导的土地重构的讨论扩展到全球南方的次级沿海城市。

articles.title_en: The impact of urban greening policies: Evidence from China’s National Garden City Program
articles.title_cn: 城市绿化政策的影响：来自中国国家园林城市计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: Urban greening has become a widely adopted policy strategy for improving environmental quality and urban livability. However, the effectiveness of large-scale government-led greening programs and their ecological outcomes remain insufficiently evaluated, particularly in rapidly urbanizing countries. China’s National Garden City Program (NGCP), implemented nationwide for more than three decades, represents one of the world’s most extensive urban greening policy initiatives. Yet its actual impacts and underlying mechanisms across different regions and city types remain unclear. Using panel data from 293 prefecture-level cities between 2000 and 2022, this study applies a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to estimate the causal effects of the NGCP on urban greening. Results show that the NGCP significantly increases urban green coverage rates, but does not produce significant improvements in NDVI. Policy impacts vary spatially, with significant improvements in northern and southern cities and sub-provincial cities, while remaining insignificant in northwestern and Qinghai–Tibet regions. Mediation analysis indicates that industrial structure adjustment contributes to improvements in built-up-area NDVI, whereas fiscal investment is not a significant pathway. These findings demonstrate that government-led greening policies can effectively expand urban greenspace quantity but may not necessarily improve greenspace quality. The study highlights the importance of multidimensional evaluation frameworks and context-sensitive governance strategies for enhancing the ecological effectiveness of urban greening programs. The findings also provide evidence to support policymakers in refining the implementation and evaluation of urban greening policies, thereby improving the ecological effectiveness of future greening initiatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市绿化已成为改善环境质量和城市宜居性的一种广泛采用的政策策略。然而，大规模政府主导的绿化计划的有效性及其生态结果仍缺乏充分评估，尤其是在快速城市化国家。中国国家园林城市计划（NGCP）在全国范围内实施已超过三十年，是世界上规模最大的城市绿化政策举措之一。然而，其在不同区域和城市类型中的实际影响及内在机制仍不清楚。本研究使用293个地级市在2000年至2022年间的面板数据，采用交错双重差分（DID）模型估计NGCP对城市绿化的因果效应。结果表明，NGCP显著提高了城市绿化覆盖率，但未对NDVI产生显著改善。政策影响存在空间差异，北方和南方城市以及副省级城市有显著改善，而西北和青藏地区仍不显著。中介分析表明，产业结构调整有助于建成区NDVI的改善，而财政投资不是显著路径。这些发现表明，政府主导的绿化政策能够有效扩大城市绿量，但未必能改善绿地质量。本研究强调了多维评估框架和情境敏感治理策略对提升城市绿化计划生态有效性的重要性。研究结果还为政策制定者完善城市绿化政策的实施和评估提供了证据支持，从而改善未来绿化举措的生态有效性。

articles.title_en: Linking global oilseed trade networks to China's cultivated land conservation: A metacoupling perspective
articles.abstract_en: With booming global trade and deepened connectivity, China, a central player in global oilseed trade networks, has not only eased domestic supply shortages but also fundamentally reshaped global resource allocation. However, the specific impacts of this trade on the quantity and quality of cultivated land protection remain under-explored. Using complex network analysis under the metacoupling framework, this study examines the evolution of major oilseed trade patterns from 2010 to 2023 and their metacoupling impacts. During 2010–2023, the global oilseed trade network exhibited escalating structural tightness and localized clustering, evidenced by a 27.2% and 24.6% increase in network density for the S1 and S2 networks, respectively, alongside a notable transition from regional fragmentation to transcontinental integration. Crucially, China’s oilseed imports activate a "Dual-track Land Sparing Mechanism": quantitatively expanding global land savings from 116.4 to 193.1 M ha, while qualitatively buffering the domestic agricultural system by trade-driven shifts in cultivation patterns, thereby stabilizing China’s domestic cultivated land pressure index at a low safety margin (0.13–0.16). This study highlights the pivotal role of trade in balancing national food security with global sustainable land management. Future policies should focus on diversifying import sources to sustain these quantity-quality benefits against supply concentration risks.

articles.title_en: Compound exposure of cropland to extreme precipitation and transportation disadvantage in China
articles.title_cn: 中国耕地对极端降水和交通劣势的复合暴露
articles.abstract_en: Global climate change and extreme precipitation events pose increasing threats to agricultural systems worldwide. However, existing studies often fail to integrate the synergistic effects of precipitation, neglect the role of transportation infrastructure, and rely on data with coarse spatial resolution. To address these gaps, this study develops a “climate–cropland–transportation” framework. By integrating high-resolution hourly precipitation data (0.1˚) and 30 m cropland distribution data, we quantified the thresholds, frequency, and intensity of extreme precipitation to construct a Cropland Extreme Precipitation Exposure (CEPE) index using the entropy weighting method. Four transportation accessibility scenarios—considering the presence or absence of expressways connecting prefecture- and county-level cities—were simulated to examine their spatial coupling with the CEPE. The results reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity in CEPE across the study area. Rural population density and industrial structure exert nonlinear regulatory effects on cropland exposure to extreme precipitation. Extreme precipitation intensity peaks at moderate population levels, while areas where the primary industry accounts for 30–40% of the economy constitute a critical buffering zone. Geographically, croplands in southwest China remain highly threatened by extreme precipitation, whereas the exposure fluctuates considerably across the Huang–Huai–Hai Plain and the Northeast China Plain. Uneven transportation accessibility further amplifies these exposures, creating vulnerability traps in regions with high exposure but low accessibility, such as the Northeast China Plain. These findings offer valuable insights for developing targeted agricultural and infrastructure strategies to strengthen agricultural resilience under climate extremes.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球气候变化和极端降水事件对全球农业系统构成日益严重的威胁。然而，现有研究往往未能整合降水的协同效应，忽视了交通基础设施的作用，且依赖空间分辨率较粗的数据。为弥补这些不足，本研究构建了“气候—耕地—交通”框架。通过整合高分辨率逐小时降水数据（0.1˚）和30 m耕地分布数据，我们量化了极端降水的阈值、频率和强度，并采用熵权法构建了耕地极端降水暴露（CEPE）指数。模拟了四种交通可达性情景——考虑连接地级市和县级市的高速公路是否存在——以考察其与CEPE的空间耦合关系。结果表明，研究区CEPE存在显著的空间异质性。农村人口密度和产业结构对耕地极端降水暴露产生非线性调节作用。极端降水强度在中等人口水平达到峰值，而第一产业占经济比重30-40%的地区构成关键缓冲带。从地理上看，中国西南地区耕地仍受极端降水高度威胁，而黄淮海平原和东北平原的暴露程度波动较大。交通可达性不均衡进一步放大了这些暴露，在高暴露但低可达性的地区（如东北平原）形成脆弱性陷阱。这些发现为制定有针对性的农业和基础设施策略、增强极端气候下的农业韧性提供了有价值的启示。

articles.title_en: Unravelling intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics: An infrastructural approach using interpretable machine-learning methods in Shenzhen, China
articles.title_cn: 解析房价动态的城市内部时空差异：基于可解释机器学习方法的基础设施研究路径——以中国深圳为例
articles.abstract_en: Housing inequalities have long been a pressing global issue, particularly in the context of rapidly transforming urban housing markets. However, intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics remain insufficiently understood. By developing an infrastructural approach operationalized through interpretable machine-learning methods that explicitly incorporate spatiotemporal heterogeneity, this study examines the complex capitalization of key infrastructures into housing prices, drawing on 288,570 second-hand housing transactions and multi-source geographic data from 2010 to 2023 in Shenzhen, one of the largest and most dynamic urban housing markets in China. The results reveal increasingly intensified housing price disparities, which are particularly pronounced within school catchment areas and 15-minute infrastructure-accessible neighborhoods. Compared with physical infrastructures, as well as structural and locational attributes, social infrastructures—especially public schools—are more decisively and consistently associated with housing prices. Their spatiotemporally heterogenous capitalization and increasingly salient threshold effects highlight the agency of social infrastructures in leveraging urban development and (re)shaping social inequalities, thereby advancing the understanding of housing price disparities. Finally, this study provides dynamic, fine-grained evidence to support locally calibrated and stage-sensitive urban planning and housing policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 住房不平等长期以来一直是全球性紧迫问题，尤其是在城市住房市场快速转型的背景下。然而，房价动态的城市内部时空差异仍未被充分理解。本研究通过构建一种基础设施研究路径，并以显式纳入时空异质性的可解释机器学习方法加以操作化，考察关键基础设施向房价的复杂资本化过程，数据来源于中国最大、最具活力的城市住房市场之一深圳的288,570条二手房交易记录以及2010年至2023年的多源地理数据。结果揭示了日益加剧的房价差异，这种差异在学区范围内以及基础设施15分钟可达的社区中尤为显著。与物质基础设施以及结构和区位属性相比，社会基础设施——尤其是公立学校——与房价的关联更为决定性和一致。其时空异质的资本化及日益突出的阈值效应凸显了社会基础设施在撬动城市发展和（再）塑造社会不平等方面的能动性，从而推进了对房价差异的理解。最后，本研究提供了动态、细粒度的证据，以支持因地制宜且具有阶段敏感性的城市规划和住房政策。

articles.title_en: Institutional relationships in urban green space governance in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Roles, interactions and policy implications for sustainable management
articles.title_cn: 加纳大塔马莱城市绿地治理中的制度关系：角色、互动及对可持续管理的政策启示
articles.abstract_en: Urban green spaces (UGSs) in rapidly urbanizing African cities are increasingly threatened by weak governance systems and institutional inefficiencies. This study investigates how formal and informal institutional arrangements shape governance responsibilities, interagency coordination, and UGS management in the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area, Ghana. Using an institutional theory framework, the research adopted a qualitative case study approach, involving 54 semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations across selected communities: Sagnarigu, Nyohini, Gumbeheni, Taha, and Kukuo. The findings reveal that UGS governance in Tamale operates through a hybrid institutional system in which statutory planning frameworks coexist with customary land tenure systems. Traditional authorities, particularly chiefs, play a significant role in land allocation and initiating planning processes, while state institutions primarily provide regulatory oversight. Although this arrangement creates opportunities for legitimacy and local participation, it also generates ambiguities in authority, weak accountability, and poor coordination among stakeholders. Collaboration tends to be stronger within institutional groupings than between local actors and formal spatial planning institutions. The study further identifies critical institutional constraints, including overlapping mandates, limited public participation, and severe staffing shortages in planning and environmental agencies. Specifically, only one of the required five physical planning officers and one of the four required development control officers were available during the study period. These institutional weaknesses, compounded by rapid urbanization and increasing land-use pressures, contribute significantly to the decline of UGS. The study concludes that strengthening coordination, accountability, participation, and institutional capacity is essential for sustainable and inclusive UGS governance.
articles.abstract_cn: 在快速城市化的非洲城市中，城市绿地（UGSs）日益受到治理体系薄弱和制度低效的威胁。本研究考察正式与非正式制度安排如何塑造加纳大塔马莱大都市区的治理责任、机构间协调和UGS管理。研究采用制度理论框架，运用定性案例研究方法，包括54次半结构化访谈、文件分析以及对选定社区Sagnarigu、Nyohini、Gumbeheni、Taha和Kukuo的实地观察。研究发现，塔马莱的UGS治理通过一种混合制度体系运作，其中法定规划框架与习惯土地保有权制度并存。传统权威，尤其是酋长，在土地分配和启动规划过程中发挥重要作用，而国家机构主要提供监管监督。尽管这种安排为合法性和地方参与创造了机会，但也产生了权威模糊、问责薄弱和利益相关者之间协调不力的问题。机构群体内部的合作往往强于地方行为者与正式空间规划机构之间的合作。研究进一步识别出关键制度约束，包括职责重叠、公众参与有限以及规划和环境机构严重的人员短缺。具体而言，在研究期间，所需的五名物理规划官员中仅有一名在岗，所需的四名开发控制官员中仅有一名在岗。这些制度弱点，加之快速城市化和日益增大的土地利用压力，显著促成了UGS的衰退。研究得出结论，加强协调、问责、参与和制度能力对于可持续和包容性的UGS治理至关重要。

articles.title_en: Private land, public benefits: Conservation covenants and easements aiding global biodiversity targets
articles.title_cn: 私有土地，公共利益：保护契约与地役权助力全球生物多样性目标
articles.abstract_en: Conservation covenants are an innovative legal mechanism that modify private property rights to promote biodiversity benefits. Their use is increasing as governments encourage private land conservation to help meet national and global biodiversity goals, such as the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. However, existing use of covenants from a variety of countries, including Australia, New Zealand and the United States, highlights some limitations. There is limited explicit accommodation of changing circumstances such as climate impacts; insufficient support to landowners and a need for increased environmental monitoring and compliance oversight. Several actions could be taken to ameliorate these and other law-related impediments, including improved reciprocity between parties to covenants, designing covenants with greater flexibility, and improving integrity mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 保护契约是一种创新性的法律机制，通过调整私有产权来促进生物多样性效益。随着各国政府鼓励私有土地保护以帮助实现国家和全球生物多样性目标（如昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架），其使用正在增加。然而，包括澳大利亚、新西兰和美国在内的多个国家现有的契约使用情况凸显了一些局限性。对气候变化影响等不断变化情况的明确适应有限；对土地所有者的支持不足，且需要加强环境监测与合规监督。可以采取若干行动来改善这些及其他与法律相关的障碍，包括改进契约各方之间的互惠性、设计更具灵活性的契约以及完善完整性机制。

articles.title_en: Deconstructing and evaluating China’s land consolidation from the dual perspective of quantity and quality
articles.title_cn: 从数量与质量双重视角解构与评估中国土地整治
articles.abstract_en: The spatiotemporal patterns of land consolidation in China have undergone profound reshaping, exerting significant impacts on socioeconomic development. Based on land use data from 2000 to 2024, this study analyzes the multi-scale spatiotemporal evolution and multidimensional effects of Chin’s land consolidation from the two dimensions of quantity and quality, specifically through cultivated land conversion area and cultivated land fragmentation. Significant spatial heterogeneity is identified. Four governance modes emerge: a "high-quantity-high-quality" synergistic improvement in the Northeast Plain; a coexistence of "high-quantity-low-quality" in the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau; a "low-quantity-high-quality" optimization in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain; and a "low-quantity-low-quality" lag in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Markov-chain forecasts indicate that cultivated land conversion is mobile under policy intervention and spatial spillovers, whereas cultivated land fragmentation remains rigid and stable due to natural constraints and spatial lock-in. Using the High-Standard Farmland Construction Policy as a quasi-natural experiment, land consolidation is found to have significantly increased grain production capacity and agricultural net carbon sequestration, while its effects on land transfer exhibit marked regional heterogeneity. Stronger policy responses in yield improvement and carbon-sink gains are observed in central western regions and major grain-producing areas, whereas land-transfer markets in eastern China are more sensitive to policy shocks. The study provides systematic empirical evidence for improving territorial-spatial governance and offers China’s experience to global sustainable land management.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国土地整治的时空格局经历了深刻重塑，对社会经济发展产生了显著影响。基于2000至2024的土地利用数据，本研究从数量和质量两个维度，具体通过耕地转换面积和耕地破碎化，分析中国土地整治的多尺度时空演变与多维效应。研究识别出显著的空间异质性。四种治理模式显现：东北平原的“高数量-高质量”协同提升；云贵高原“高数量-低质量”并存；黄淮海平原的“低数量-高质量”优化；以及青藏高原的“低数量-低质量”滞后。马尔可夫链预测表明，耕地转换在政策干预和空间溢出下具有流动性，而耕地破碎化由于自然约束和空间锁定而保持刚性和稳定。以高标准农田建设政策作为准自然实验，发现土地整治显著提高了粮食生产能力和农业净碳汇，而其对该土地流转的影响表现出明显的区域异质性。在中西部地区和粮食主产区，产量提升和碳汇增益的政策响应更强，而东部地区的土地流转市场对政策冲击更为敏感。本研究为完善国土空间治理提供了系统的经验证据，并为全球可持续土地管理提供了中国经验。

articles.title_en: Reconfiguring deforestation drivers in Brazil’s Legal Amazon after 2018: Climate, agricultural production, and environmental governance
articles.title_cn: 2018之后巴西亚马逊法定区域森林砍伐驱动因素的重构：气候、农业生产与环境治理
articles.abstract_en: Deforestation in Brazil’s Legal Amazon increased sharply after 2018, renewing concerns about environmental governance and frontier expansion. Yet it remains unclear whether this surge reflected only higher forest loss or a deeper reconfiguration of land-use drivers. The study examines whether the relationships linking municipal deforestation to governance, climate, and agricultural expansion changed after 2018. Using a municipality-year panel covering 634 municipalities for 2010–2021, the study combines satellite-based deforestation data, municipal economic accounts, gridded climate indicators, and environmental enforcement records in panel interaction and event-study models, complemented by an aggregate break-date assessment and spatial comparisons between the arc of deforestation and the interior Amazon. The results are consistent with a post-2018 reconfiguration of deforestation dynamics rather than only an increase in forest-loss levels. After 2018, the already positive enforcement–deforestation association strengthened substantially, indicating a change in magnitude rather than a sign reversal. This pattern is consistent with enforcement actions becoming increasingly concentrated in municipalities under greater deforestation pressure. Baseline estimates suggest that precipitation becomes more positively associated with deforestation while temperature loses explanatory relevance. These climatic shifts are sensitive to specifications that absorb time-varying spatial shocks, while the agricultural channel strengthens mainly outside the consolidated frontier. The baseline estimates are also spatially uneven: precipitation is positively associated with deforestation in the arc but negatively associated in the interior. These findings point to a qualitative restructuring of land-use pressures and support policy responses that combine restored enforcement with spatially differentiated governance strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2018之后，巴西亚马逊法定区域的森林砍伐急剧增加，重新引发了对环境治理和边疆扩张的担忧。然而，目前尚不清楚这一激增仅反映了森林损失的增加，还是土地利用驱动因素发生了更深层次的重构。本研究考察了市级森林砍伐与治理、气候和农业扩张之间的关系在2018之后是否发生了变化。研究使用覆盖634个市、时间跨度为2010-2021的市级—年度面板数据，将基于卫星的森林砍伐数据、市级经济账户、网格化气候指标和环境执法记录结合于面板交互模型和事件研究模型中，并辅以总体断点日期评估以及森林砍伐弧线与亚马逊内陆之间的空间比较。结果与2018之后森林砍伐动态发生重构相一致，而不仅仅是森林损失水平的上升。在2018之后，本已为正的执法—森林砍伐关联显著增强，表明变化体现在幅度上而非符号反转。这一模式与执法行动日益集中于面临更大森林砍伐压力的市相一致。基准估计表明，降水与森林砍伐的正向关联增强，而温度则失去解释相关性。这些气候变化对吸收时变空间冲击的设定较为敏感，而农业渠道主要在已整合边疆之外增强。基准估计在空间上也不均衡：降水在森林砍伐弧线与森林砍伐正相关，而在内陆地区则呈负相关。这些发现表明土地利用压力发生了质性重构，并支持将恢复执法与空间差异化治理策略相结合的政策应对。

articles.title_en: Salinity fundamentally reshapes crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios in a high-value agricultural landscape
articles.title_cn: 盐度从根本上重塑高价值农业景观中的作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合
articles.abstract_en: Salinity intrusion is an emerging threat in low‑lying regions as climate‑driven fluvial/tidal flooding intensifies. Yet its impacts remain poorly characterised due to focus on biophysical processes and limited understanding of how it affects agricultural productivity, profitability, and risk exposure. The study sought to quantify the impact of flood‑induced salinisation on crop productivity and profitability, assess how it alters risk-return relationships, and evaluate how this affects crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios. The study focused on Greater Lincolnshire, United Kingdom as a case, and used spatially explicit crop, land‑grade, and flood‑risk datasets integrated with enterprise‑level gross‑margin modelling, Monte‑Carlo simulation, and cross‑crop competitiveness analysis. Without flood-induced salinisation, profitability varies across crops, with margins from £ 1114/ha for beet and £ 825/ha for winter wheat to £ 255/ha for potatoes. Under the salinity scenario, all crops incur substantial losses from simulated yield declines. Potatoes show the greatest drop (–£1382/ha), followed by beet (–£442/ha) and cereals such as winter wheat (–£339/ha), spring wheat (–£273/ha), and spring barley (–£304/ha). Risk-return analysis reveals that salinity systematically collapses the profitability hierarchy across crops, compressing them into a uniformly low‑return, moderate‑risk zone and thereby eliminating the high‑value production opportunities that currently underpin regional agricultural competitiveness. Competitiveness shifts markedly, with potatoes most disadvantaged and barley relatively resilient, while portfolio optimisation indicates strong reallocation toward winter wheat. Overall, the scenario suggests that flood‑induced salinisation could become a transformative constraint without flood defences, underscoring the need for proactive mitigation policies, adaptive planning, and investment in salt‑tolerant crop options.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着气候驱动的河流/潮汐洪水加剧，盐水入侵正在成为低洼地区的新兴威胁。然而，由于研究聚焦于生物物理过程，且对其如何影响农业生产率、盈利能力和风险暴露的认识有限，其影响仍缺乏充分刻画。本研究旨在量化洪水引发的盐渍化对作物生产率和盈利能力的影响，评估其如何改变风险-收益关系，并评价其如何影响作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合。研究以英国大林肯郡为案例，使用空间显式的作物、土地等级和洪水风险数据集，并结合企业级毛利润建模、蒙特卡洛模拟和跨作物竞争力分析。在没有洪水引发的盐渍化的情况下，盈利能力因作物而异，利润率从甜菜的£1114/公顷和冬小麦的£825/公顷到马铃薯的£255/公顷不等。在盐度情景下，所有作物都因模拟产量下降而遭受重大损失。马铃薯降幅最大（–£1382/公顷），其次是甜菜（–£442/公顷）以及冬小麦（–£339/公顷）、春小麦（–£273/公顷）和春大麦（–£304/公顷）等谷物。风险-收益分析表明，盐度系统性地瓦解了作物间的盈利能力等级，将它们压缩到一个统一的低收益、中等风险区域，从而消除了目前支撑区域农业竞争力的高价值生产机会。竞争力发生显著变化，马铃薯处于最不利地位，大麦相对具有韧性，而组合优化表明强烈重新配置向冬小麦。总体而言，该情景表明，在没有防洪设施的情况下，洪水引发的盐渍化可能成为一项变革性约束，凸显了采取主动缓解政策、适应性规划和投资耐盐作物选项的必要性。

articles.title_en: When governments shift, do policies follow?Tracing policy change in Brazil’s land use regulatory framework
articles.title_cn: 当政府更迭时，政策会随之改变吗？追踪巴西土地利用监管框架中的政策变化
articles.abstract_en: Land degradation and native vegetation loss in Brazil have persisted despite a comprehensive land use regulatory framework. This study examines how Brazilian federal land use policies changed between 2000 and 2025 and how these changes relate to institutional government change. Drawing on historical institutionalism, qualitative policy analysis, and process tracing, the research analyzes 239 laws and decrees across eight environmental and agricultural policies over eight administrations. The findings show that policy goals persisted across governments, while rules, instruments, budgets, and institutional capacities shifted. Two critical junctures, Dilma Rousseff’s impeachment in 2015 and the start of Bolsonaro’s presidency in 2019, coincided with environmental policy replacement, institutional dismantling, and weakened enforcement. However, prior layering and conversion of environmental policies created resilience, enabling institutional recovery under Lula’s third administration beginning in 2023. Agricultural policies exhibited greater stability, reflecting entrenched economic and political coalitions. Linking policy change processes to vegetation loss data shows that periods of weakened implementation were associated with increased vegetation loss, whereas restored institutional coordination was associated with reduced deforestation. Targeted strategies, especially the Action Plans for the Prevention and Control of Deforestation, were highly effective when supported by institutional capacity. This study calls for greater integration between agricultural and environmental policies, using cross-compliant financial and technical instruments to combat land use change driving vegetation loss, matched with continued whole-territory monitoring and targeted actions across biomes. The findings underscore the critical role of stable interministerial coordination and long-term institutional foundations in sustaining conservation policy amid political volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管巴西拥有全面的土地利用监管框架，土地退化和原生植被丧失仍持续存在。本研究考察了2000至2025年间巴西联邦土地利用政策如何变化，以及这些变化与政府机构性更迭的关系。研究借鉴历史制度主义、定性政策分析和过程追踪方法，分析了八届政府期间八项环境与农业政策中的239项法律和法令。研究发现，政策目标在各届政府间保持延续，而规则、工具、预算和机构能力则发生变动。两个关键节点——2015年迪尔玛·罗塞夫遭弹劾和2019年博索纳罗总统任期开始——与环境政策替换、机构拆解和执法弱化同时发生。然而，此前环境政策的层叠和转换创造了韧性，使机构得以在2023年开始的卢拉第三届政府时期恢复。农业政策表现出更大的稳定性，反映了根深蒂固的经济和政治联盟。将政策变化过程与植被丧失数据相联系表明，执行弱化时期与植被丧失增加相关，而恢复的机构协调则与森林砍伐减少相关。有针对性的策略，尤其是预防和控制森林砍伐行动计划，在得到机构能力支持时极为有效。本研究呼吁加强农业与环境政策之间的整合，利用交叉合规的财政和技术工具来应对驱动植被丧失的土地利用变化，并配合持续的全域监测和跨生物群系的有针对性行动。研究结果强调了稳定的跨部门协调和长期机构基础在政治波动中维持保护政策的关键作用。

articles.title_en: Spatial identification of rural areas under urban sprawl pressure: Preventive land-use policy framework for Antalya (Turkey)
articles.title_cn: 城市蔓延压力下乡村地区的空间识别：安塔利亚（土耳其）的预防性土地利用政策框架
articles.abstract_en: Urban sprawl is a major spatial transformation process characterized by the unplanned expansion of urban areas into surrounding rural and natural landscapes. As a result, rural areas at the urban fringe are increasingly exposed to pressures driven by population growth, housing demand, and expanding transportation infrastructure, giving rise to hybrid “rurban” landscapes. Managing these areas requires not only monitoring land use change but also identifying zones at risk of transformation before irreversible change occurs.Since the 1980s, Antalya has experienced rapid population growth, tourism-driven economic expansion, and largely uncoordinated development, leading to significant changes in surrounding agricultural and rural landscapes. This study develops a Geographic Information System (GIS) and remote sensing–based spatial analysis framework to systematically identify rural areas under urban sprawl pressure. The approach integrates the direction and intensity of urban expansion with existing rural land use patterns to examine their spatial interactions.Using multi-temporal satellite imagery within a GIS environment, the spatio-temporal dynamics of urban growth were analyzed and rural areas with high susceptibility to urban encroachment were delineated. The results show that the impacts of urban sprawl extend beyond existing built-up areas and are increasingly concentrated in transitional rural zones that remain unurbanized yet are critical for planning.The identified spatial patterns provide a basis for an early warning framework to support the protection of agricultural land and the development of preventive land use policies. Although tested in Antalya, the proposed framework is transferable to regions experiencing similar urbanization dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市蔓延是一个主要的空间转型过程，其特征是城市地区无计划地扩张到周边乡村和自然景观中。因此，城市边缘的乡村地区日益暴露于人口增长、住房需求和交通基础设施扩张所驱动的压力之下，产生了混合的“城乡结合”景观。管理这些地区不仅需要监测土地利用变化，还需要在不可逆转的变化发生之前识别面临转型风险的区域。自1980以来，安塔利亚经历了快速的人口增长、旅游驱动的经济扩张以及很大程度上缺乏协调的发展，导致周边农业和乡村景观发生显著变化。本研究开发了一个基于地理信息系统（GIS）和遥感的空间分析框架，以系统识别城市蔓延压力下的乡村地区。该方法将城市扩张的方向和强度与现有乡村土地利用格局相结合，以考察它们的空间相互作用。在GIS环境中利用多时相卫星影像，分析了城市增长的空间-时间动态，并划定了易受城市侵占影响的乡村地区。结果表明，城市蔓延的影响超出了现有建成区，并日益集中在尚未城市化但对规划至关重要的过渡性乡村地带。所识别的空间格局为早期预警框架提供了基础，以支持农业用地保护和预防性土地利用政策的制定。尽管在安塔利亚进行了测试，但所提出的框架可推广到经历类似城市化动态的地区。

articles.title_en: How does coordinated land transfer promote the standardization of contracts?
articles.title_cn: 协调土地流转如何促进合同标准化？
articles.abstract_en: Despite rapid expansion of farmland transfer in rural China, the quality of contractual governance often fails to keep pace, raising the question of whether spatial consolidation arrangements can promote more complete contract terms. This study examines how coordinated land transfer promotes the standardization of farmland rental contracts within China’s three-rights separation framework. Drawing on primary household survey data from 1101 farming households across four counties in Guizhou Province, this study documents a robust positive relationship between the degree of spatial contiguity in transfer arrangements and the level of contract standardization. Mediation analysis applying the KHB decomposition method reveals that this effect is transmitted primarily through two operational channels: economies of scale and technology adaptation through mechanization adoption. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the standardization effect concentrates among operators with greater financial capacity, in regions with stronger market connectivity and irrigation infrastructure, and in villages where collective governance is comparatively weak.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管中国农村农地流转迅速扩张，但契约治理质量往往未能同步提升，这引出了空间整合安排能否促进更完整合同条款的问题。本研究考察在中国三权分置框架内，协调土地流转如何促进农地租赁合同的标准化。基于贵州省四个县1101户农户的一手入户调查数据，本研究记录了流转安排的空间连片程度与合同标准化水平之间稳健的正向关系。采用KHB分解方法的中介分析表明，这一效应主要通过两条操作渠道传导：规模经济与通过机械化采纳实现的技术适应。异质性分析进一步揭示，标准化效应集中于资金能力较强的经营者、市场连通性和灌溉基础设施较强的地区，以及集体治理相对薄弱的村庄。

articles.title_en: Declining greenness under the rapid expansion of the wildland–urban interface on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
articles.title_cn: 青藏高原野地-城市界面快速扩张下绿色度下降
articles.abstract_en: The wildland–urban interface (WUI) refers to zones where buildings intersect with undeveloped wildland vegetation, and identifying its ecological effects is crucial for understanding human–environment conflicts in relation to landscapes. Current WUI assessments have focused primarily on areas with high-density human activity in developed countries, with limited evidence of vegetation degradation in ecologically vulnerable regions with rapid increases in human activity, e.g., the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau (QTP). We mapped the WUI at a 100-m resolution from 2000 to 2020 on the QTP and quantified vegetation greenness degradation within WUI expansion areas based on the normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), leaf area index (LAI) and solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF), using propensity score matching (PSM) to control for environmental covariate bias and a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach to eliminate background temporal trends, thereby quantifying the net suppressive effect of WUI expansion on vegetation.The results revealed that the WUI area expanded by 48% over the 20-year period, and the expansion was concentrated mainly at the western, southern, southeastern, and eastern margins of the QTP. Urban expansion had a mean total contribution of 89.6% to WUI expansion, approximately 9 times that of wildland. LAI degradation was 11.57%, NDVI degradation was 2.48%, and SIF degradation was 2.06%; all three indicators exhibited consistent degradation directions, confirming that the impact of WUI expansion on vegetation is dominated by leaf area loss and canopy structural simplification. Direct land conversion is the primary driver of LAI degradation, which proceeds through multiple pathways including direct clearing, landscape reorganisation with fragmentation amplification, and the concentration of grazing pressure.
articles.abstract_cn: 野地-城市界面（WUI）指建筑物与未开发野地植被相交的区域，识别其生态效应对于理解与景观相关的人-环境冲突至关重要。当前的WUI评估主要集中于发达国家人类活动高密度地区，对人类活动快速增加且生态脆弱区域（如青藏高原，QTP）植被退化的证据有限。我们在青藏高原绘制了100米分辨率、2000至2020年的WUI，并基于归一化差异植被指数（NDVI）、叶面积指数（LAI）和日光诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF），量化了WUI扩张区域内植被绿色度退化，使用倾向得分匹配（PSM）控制环境协变量偏差，并采用双重差分（DiD）方法消除背景时间趋势，从而量化WUI扩张对植被的净抑制效应。结果表明，WUI面积在20年期间扩张了48%，扩张主要集中在青藏高原的西部、南部、东南部和东部边缘。城市扩张对WUI扩张的平均总贡献为89.6%，约为野地的9倍。LAI退化为11.57%，NDVI退化为2.48%，SIF退化为2.06%；三个指标均表现出一致的退化方向，证实WUI扩张对植被的影响以叶面积损失和冠层结构简化为主要特征。直接土地转换是LAI退化的主要驱动因素，其通过直接清除、伴随破碎化放大的景观重组以及放牧压力集中等多条路径发生。

articles.title_en: Implementing municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility: A spatial diagnosis of Kraków in the context of urban planning reforms
articles.title_cn: 实施软基础设施可达性的市政标准：城市规划改革背景下克拉科夫的空间诊断
articles.abstract_en: Dynamic urbanisation processes in Poland, including land development pressure and oversupply of buildable land, pose increasing challenges in ensuring equal access to soft infrastructure for local populations. These problems are addressed in the 2023 amendment to the Act on spatial planning and development. It allows for defining municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility in master plans. The study diagnoses the spatial accessibility of the infrastructure in Kraków and evaluates the compliance of the existing soft infrastructure with the new statutory standards. Its novelty lies in being the first attempt at operationalising the new regulations in an empirical analysis that uses network-based GIS methodology. The analyses were performed with the QNEAT3 plugin for QGIS using the statutory distance limits. The results show that 77% and 93% of parcels in Kraków conform to school and public green spaces accessibility criteria, respectively. However, only 56% of the city area has access to both types of soft infrastructure simultaneously; eastern and peripheral parts of the city are clearly disadvantaged. Overall, Kraków is relatively well prepared to implement soft infrastructure accessibility standards, but the findings revealed an integration gap across housing, transport, and environmental policies. The evidence can serve as a reference for other municipalities in Poland and internationally, including in Eastern European countries, following the sociopolitical transformation for implementing new spatial planning tools.
articles.abstract_cn: 波兰的动态城市化进程，包括土地开发压力和可建设土地供应过剩，对确保当地居民平等获取软基础设施提出了日益严峻的挑战。这些问题在《空间规划与开发法》2023修正案中得到处理。该修正案允许在总体规划中界定软基础设施可达性的市政标准。本研究诊断了克拉科夫软基础设施的空间可达性，并评估现有软基础设施与新法定标准的符合程度。其新颖性在于首次尝试在采用基于网络的GIS方法的实证分析中将新法规操作化。分析使用QGIS的QNEAT3插件并采用法定距离限制进行。结果表明，克拉科夫分别有77%和93%的地块符合学校和公共绿地的可达性标准。然而，仅有56%的城市区域能够同时获得这两类软基础设施；城市东部和外围地区明显处于劣势。总体而言，克拉科夫在实施软基础设施可达性标准方面准备相对充分，但研究结果揭示了住房、交通和环境政策之间的整合缺口。这些证据可为波兰及其他国家（包括东欧国家）在经历社会政治转型后实施新的空间规划工具的其他市政当局提供参考。

articles.title_en: An integrated framework for adaptive land use optimization through multidimensional evaluation and geospatial simulation: A case study of Lingbao City, China
articles.title_cn: 通过多维评价与地理空间模拟的自适应土地利用优化集成框架：中国灵宝市案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Land use optimization plays pivotal roles in bridging regional sustainable development with national strategic priorities, yet persistent methodological disconnects between diagnostic evaluation and prescriptive optimization hinder practical implementation. Addressing this critical gap, this research develops an integrated “Evaluation-Diagnosis-Simulation-Optimization” (EDSO) framework through synergistic coupling of multi-dimensional functional indices, PLUS modeling, and random forest. The framework utilizes multi-source geospatial data with Lingbao City, Henan Province, China, as the case study area. The results indicate that the transition marked by 1.40% farmland loss due to forest regeneration and urban-rural construction expansion, while non-agricultural output value surged by 23.09% alongside improved infrastructure accessibility (2012–2020). Rural depopulation paralleled the degradation of commercial and public services, exposing vulnerabilities in rural governance. The simulation demonstrates the comprehensive optimized scenario's superiority in landscape efficiency, with 280 million CNY higher ecological value than alternatives. The optimized schedule identified 200.22 km² of land returned to forest and 4.32 km² of fragmented rural low-efficiency built-up land. The schedule identified forest carbon sink peaking at 35-year tree growth cycles, critical insights informing 30m-resolution rotation scheme. The EDSO framework's ability to integrate diagnostic analytics with spatially adaptive interventions offers a transformative toolkit for territorial planning, effectively bridging the science-policy gap.
articles.abstract_cn: 土地利用优化在连接区域可持续发展与国家战略优先事项方面发挥着关键作用，但诊断性评价与规范性优化之间长期存在的方法论脱节阻碍了实际实施。针对这一关键空白，本研究通过多维功能指数、PLUS模型和随机森林的协同耦合，开发了一个集成的“评价-诊断-模拟-优化”（EDSO）框架。该框架利用多源地理空间数据，以中国河南省灵宝市作为案例研究区。结果表明，以1.40%耕地因森林再生和城乡建设用地扩张而流失为标志的转变，同时非农产值激增23.09%，基础设施可达性改善（2012-2020）。农村人口减少与商业和公共服务退化并行，暴露了农村治理的脆弱性。模拟表明，综合优化情景在景观效率方面具有优越性，其生态价值比替代方案高280百万元人民币。优化方案确定了200.22 km²的退耕还林土地和4.32 km²的碎片化农村低效建设用地。该方案确定了森林碳汇在35年树木生长周期达到峰值，这些关键见解为30m分辨率轮伐方案提供了信息。EDSO框架将诊断分析与空间自适应干预相结合的能力为国土规划提供了变革性工具包，有效弥合了科学与政策之间的差距。

articles.title_en: No water, no gain: The impact of large-scale water transfers on urban land markets
articles.title_cn: 无水则无获：大规模调水对城市土地市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of water availability on the urban land market by focusing on a large-scale inter-basin water transfer project in China. Employing a difference-in-differences framework and a unique parcel-level dataset, we find that the project increased average land prices in water-receiving areas by 8.47% while also stimulating urban land market activity, and ultimately promote urban economic growth and expansion. These effects are primarily driven by two channels: population growth and mobility, and accelerated industrial expansion—all induced by the large-scale water transfer. Additional analyses further reveal that the project’s influence on land price is almost entirely concentrated in residential and commercial land parcels, with negligible effects observed for industrial land. And the positive impacts are more pronounced along the project’s middle route and in arid counties. Notably, we find no empirical evidence of adverse effects on land markets in water-supplying areas. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the appreciation in land values could recoup over one-third of the project’s total investment, underscoring its substantial economic benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过聚焦中国一项大规模跨流域调水工程，考察水资源可得性对城市土地市场的影响。采用双重差分框架和独特的宗地层面数据集，我们发现该工程使受水区平均土地价格提高了8.47%，同时刺激了城市土地市场活动，并最终促进城市经济增长与扩张。这些效应主要由两个渠道驱动：人口增长与流动，以及加速的产业扩张——均由大规模调水引起。进一步分析还揭示，该工程对土地价格的影响几乎完全集中在住宅和商业地块，对工业用地的效应可忽略不计。且正向影响在工程中线沿线及干旱县更为显著。值得注意的是，我们未发现对供水区土地市场产生不利影响的实证证据。一项粗略估算表明，土地价值升值可收回工程总投资的超过三分之一，凸显其显著的经济效益。

articles.title_en: Climate and land-use change impacts on pastoral systems in the Ferlo, Senegal: Perceptions and adaptation strategies
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与土地利用变化对塞内加尔费尔洛牧区系统的影响：感知与适应策略
articles.abstract_en: Transhumant pastoralism is a major livelihood system in West Africa, supporting food security and household incomes while remaining highly vulnerable to climatic variability and land-use change. This study investigates pastoralists’ perceptions of climate variability and land-use change, their impacts on pastoral resources and practices, and the adaptation strategies adopted in the Ferlo region of Senegal. Climate trends for the period 1981–2024 were assessed using ETCCDI climate indices and Sen’s slope, while pastoral perceptions, constraints, and adaptation strategies were analysed from a survey of 306 transhumant, sedentary, and agropastoral herders across six municipalities using descriptive statistics and correspondence analysis. Results showed significant warming of nighttime temperatures across the three study sites, with increasing warm nights and declining cool nights, while rainfall trends varied spatially. Pastoralists reported contrasting constraints across production systems. Transhumant herders primarily associated environmental change with mobility constraints, including blocked transhumance corridors, water scarcity, conflicts, and cross-border restrictions, whereas sedentary and agropastoral herders more frequently reported pasture degradation, declining forage quality, and feed shortages. Land-use change and land fragmentation further restricted access to grazing resources and water points and contributed to farmer-herder conflicts. Adaptation strategies differed across production systems: transhumant herders relied strongly on transhumance (100%), herd diversification (69%), and herd reduction (66.7%), whereas sedentary and agropastoral herders relied extensively on feed supplementation and crop-residue storage. Traditional ethnoveterinary practices also supported livestock health management. These findings highlight the urgent need for policies that secure pastoral mobility, protect transhumance corridors, and strengthen inclusive land and resource governance. Supporting community-based management and reinforcing agropastoral synergies are critical to enhancing the resilience of pastoral systems under growing climatic and socio-institutional pressures.
articles.abstract_cn: 游牧是西非主要的生计系统，支撑粮食安全和家庭收入，同时仍高度易受气候变异和土地利用变化的影响。本研究考察塞内加尔费尔洛地区牧民对气候变异和土地利用变化的感知、其对牧区资源和实践的影响以及所采取的适应策略。使用ETCCDI气候指数和Sen斜率评估了1981-2024期间的气候趋势，同时基于对六个市镇306名游牧、定居和农牧兼营牧民的调查，使用描述性统计和对应分析分析了牧民的感知、约束和适应策略。结果表明，三个研究地点夜间温度均显著变暖，暖夜增加、冷夜减少，而降雨趋势在空间上存在差异。牧民报告了不同生产系统下截然不同的约束。游牧牧民主要将环境变化与流动性约束联系起来，包括迁徙走廊受阻、水资源短缺、冲突和跨境限制，而定居和农牧兼营牧民更频繁地报告牧场退化、饲草质量下降和饲料短缺。土地利用变化和土地细碎化进一步限制了获取放牧资源和水点的机会，并助长了农牧民冲突。适应策略因生产系统而异：游牧牧民强烈依赖游牧（100%）、畜群多样化（69%）和畜群缩减（66.7%），而定居和农牧兼营牧民则广泛依赖饲料补充和作物秸秆储存。传统民族兽医实践也支持了牲畜健康管理。这些发现凸显了迫切需要制定保障牧区流动性、保护迁徙走廊并加强包容性土地和资源治理的政策。支持社区为基础的管理和加强农牧协同对于增强牧区系统在不断加剧的气候和社会制度压力下的韧性至关重要。

articles.title_en: The evolution of territorial agrifood systems between global and local dynamics: Insights from hazelnut production in Tuscia (Italy)
articles.title_cn: 全球与地方动态之间地域农业食品系统的演变：来自意大利图西亚榛子生产的洞见
articles.abstract_en: Globalisation and industrialisation have over time generated profound changes in the agrifood system, producing multiple effects with strong spatial characteristics. These include de-territorialisation, accompanied by standardisation, specialisation and intensification. These processes have often determined significant impacts on rural territories and communities, due to the primacy of specific economic interests over the priorities of local socio-ecological systems. As a reaction to these dynamics, new paths have emerged, oriented to food re-localisation and sustainability transition and, more generally, seeking a more democratic approach in governing food systems and local development. Transitions of territorial agrifood systems indeed become the outcome of complex interaction dynamics established among different, multi-scale networks, reflecting their respective visions, objectives and power. Against such a background, this paper aims to contribute to the understanding of the transformations of specific territorial agrifood systems, marked by tensions between global forces and local dynamics. To that end it applies an analytical framework interrelating actors’ role and interactions, discursive components, and policies and governance issues. Focusing on the rural area of Tuscia (Italy), it analyses the expansion of the problematic hazelnut production. Tracing the long-term evolution of the territorial agrifood system and of governance dynamics, it reflects on the critical issues associated with the presence of global-scale economic activities in specific territorial contexts, and on the challenges faced by sustainable, locally tailored and community-driven development trajectories. The analysis helps deepen understanding of these processes and provides significant insights for the scientific debate, policy-makers and social groups involved in this type of process.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球化和工业化随着时间的推移在农业食品系统中产生了深刻变化，产生了具有强烈空间特征的多重效应。这些效应包括去地域化，并伴随标准化、专业化和集约化。由于特定经济利益优先于地方社会生态系统的优先事项，这些过程往往对农村地域和社区造成重大影响。作为对这些动态的回应，出现了新的路径，导向食物再地方化和可持续性转型，更一般地说，寻求在治理食品系统和地方发展中采取更民主的方式。地域农业食品系统的转型确实成为不同多尺度网络之间建立的复杂互动动态的结果，反映了它们各自的愿景、目标和权力。在此背景下，本文旨在促进对特定地域农业食品系统转型的理解，这些转型以全球力量与地方动态之间的张力为标志。为此，本文应用了一个将行动者角色与互动、话语成分以及政策与治理问题相互关联的分析框架。聚焦于意大利图西亚农村地区，本文分析了有问题的榛子生产的扩张。通过追踪地域农业食品系统和治理动态的长期演变，本文反思了与全球尺度经济活动在特定地域情境中存在相关的关键问题，以及可持续的、因地制宜的和社区驱动的发展轨迹所面临的挑战。该分析有助于加深对这些过程的理解，并为科学辩论、政策制定者和参与此类过程的社会群体提供了重要洞见。

articles.title_en: Sustainable spatial planning for coastal islands: Integrating ecological resilience and development suitability in China’s county-level island administrative divisions
articles.title_cn: 沿海岛屿的可持续空间规划：整合中国县级岛屿行政区划中的生态韧性与开发适宜性
articles.abstract_en: Owing to the confined area, clear spatial boundaries, and heterogeneous characteristics, islands serve as ideal natural laboratories for developing territorial spatial planning techniques. This study addresses the disconnection between ecosystem-based assessments and practical planning across China's 12 major island counties. We established fine-resolution (100 m × 100 m) models of island ecological resilience and development suitability based on element couplings. Results revealed significant national-scale spatial heterogeneity: ecological resilience is predominantly influenced by human activities, a dominant role demonstrated here for the first time at this scale, while development suitability is primarily controlled by soil, topography, and coastline proximity. These models informed three multi-scenario conservation zonings and five region-specific functional zonings, whose integration generated 15 planning schemes dividing the study area into core conservation, buffer conservation, permanent farmland, urban development, and integrated development zones. Theoretically, we demonstrate that element couplings exhibit systematic spatial heterogeneity and that aggregation scale directly influences planning outcomes, establishing region-specific parameterization as a necessity. Methodologically, the "realism and orientation" principles bridge technical assessment and implementation by embedding feasibility and strategic direction as explicit selection criteria. Guided by these principles, we selected optimal solutions for each county. We further identified four development orientations, namely, nature conservation, agricultural production, urban development, and integrated multifunction, for 209 individual islands and the 12 counties, and proposed management strategies aligned with China's "Three Zones and Three Lines" framework. Beyond China, the study offers three actionable insights for island regions worldwide: regulating human activity intensity as the primary driver of ecological resilience, adopting region-specific planning within national frameworks, and complementing technical zoning with integrated management strategies . The findings validate that multi-scenario and region-specific techniques effectively balance ecological assessments with societal needs, bridging research and practice in spatial planning. This framework is transferable to other archipelagic regions and to any context where spatial heterogeneity of coupling parameters is significant.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于面积有限、空间边界清晰且具有异质性特征，岛屿是发展国土空间规划技术的理想天然实验室。本研究针对中国12个主要岛屿县中基于生态系统的评估与实际规划之间的脱节问题。我们基于要素耦合建立了精细分辨率（100 m × 100 m）的岛屿生态韧性与开发适宜性模型。结果揭示了显著的国家尺度空间异质性：生态韧性主要受人类活动影响，此处首次在该尺度上展示了这一主导作用，而开发适宜性主要受土壤、地形和海岸线邻近度控制。这些模型支撑了三种多情景保护分区和五种区域特定功能分区，其整合生成了15个规划方案，将研究区划分为核心保护区、缓冲保护区、永久农田、城市发展区和综合发展区。在理论上，我们证明要素耦合表现出系统性空间异质性，且聚合尺度直接影响规划结果，从而确立区域特定参数化为必要条件。在方法上，“现实性与导向性”原则通过将可行性和战略方向作为明确的选择标准嵌入，桥接了技术评估与实施。在这些原则指导下，我们为每个县选择了最优方案。我们进一步为209个单个岛屿和12个县确定了四种发展方向，即自然保护、农业生产、城市发展和综合多功能，并提出了与中国“三区三线”框架相一致的管理策略。在中国之外，本研究为全球岛屿地区提供了三条可操作见解：将人类活动强度作为生态韧性的主要驱动因素加以调控，在国家框架内采用区域特定规划，以及以综合管理策略补充技术分区。研究结果验证了多情景和区域特定技术有效平衡了生态评估与社会需求，桥接了空间规划中的研究与实践。该框架可迁移至其他群岛地区以及耦合参数空间异质性显著的任何情境。

articles.title_en: (Un)polarized forests? Disentangling drivers of polarization in the public debate around German forests affected by climate change
articles.title_cn: （去）极化的森林？解析围绕受气候变化影响的德国森林的公共辩论中极化驱动因素
articles.abstract_en: Polarization is an increasingly prevalent issue in environmental conflicts, often simplified as two opposing arguments. However, most studies lack theoretical conceptualizations of polarization to reveal its complexity, drivers, and effects. By combining concepts of polarization with discourse analysis, this study provides a nuanced perspective on the social construction of land-use conflicts and their surrounding polarization. It demonstrates how disentangling underlying drivers and power relations enhances the understanding of conflicts, considering their context-specificity. To this end, I empirically scrutinize the factors of the deep-rooted conflict between forestry and nature conservation in Germany. The analysis focuses on public and political debates between 2018 and 2020 on forests affected by climate change. Large-scale forest damage has sparked controversy over whether to actively adapt forests or rely on the ecosystem’s self-regulation. While both sides instrumentalize climate change to emphasize the urgency of their measures to ‘save’ the forests and make them climate-resilient, the results demonstrate the entanglements of narratives and subject positions beyond this dichotomy. Rather than being issue-related, polarization is mainly driven by affective sentiments toward pre-constructed actor groups that are discursively reproduced. Polarization is further reinforced through perceived polarization, expressed through simplifications, generalizations, misconceptions, and dismissive reframing of opposing arguments. Instead of taking the negative effects of polarization for granted, the discussion highlights the need for research to critically reflect on the dynamics of polarization and the ways in which it manifests. This understanding is crucial for resolving entrenched debates, unfolding the generative potential of conflict, and allowing alternative solutions to emerge.
articles.abstract_cn: 极化是环境冲突中日益普遍的问题，常被简化为两种对立的论点。然而，大多数研究缺乏对极化的理论概念化，以揭示其复杂性、驱动因素和影响。通过将极化概念与话语分析相结合，本研究为土地利用冲突及其周围极化的社会建构提供了细致的视角。它展示了如何通过解析潜在驱动因素和权力关系来增强对冲突的理解，并考虑其情境特定性。为此，我实证审视了德国林业与自然保护之间根深蒂固冲突的因素。分析聚焦于2018至2020年间关于受气候变化影响森林的公共和政治辩论。大规模森林损害引发了关于是主动适应森林还是依赖生态系统自我调节的争议。尽管双方都将气候变化工具化，以强调其“拯救”森林并使其具有气候韧性措施的紧迫性，但结果展示了超越这一二分法的话语与主体位置的纠缠。极化主要不是由议题相关因素驱动，而是由对预先建构的行动者群体的情感情绪所驱动，这些群体被话语性地再生产。极化通过感知到的极化进一步强化，表现为简化、概括、误解以及对对立论点的轻蔑性重构。讨论并未将极化的负面影响视为理所当然，而是强调研究需要批判性地反思极化的动态及其表现形式。这种理解对于解决根深蒂固的辩论、展开冲突的生成性潜力以及允许替代性解决方案出现至关重要。

articles.title_en: CAP regime shifts, institutional quality, and technical efficiency in agricultural land use across the EU: A panel stochastic frontier analysis
articles.title_cn: CAP制度变迁、制度质量与欧盟农业土地利用的技术效率：面板随机前沿分析
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) payment intensity and national governance quality jointly shape technical efficiency in agricultural land use. The sample covers the 27 EU member states over 2005–2022, giving 486 balanced observations. We estimate a per-hectare panel stochastic frontier model. Per-hectare normalisation lowers the maximum variance inflation factor from 14.98 to 3.25. CAP payment intensity is the inverse hyperbolic sine of the implicit subsidy per hectare of utilised agricultural area (UAA). This measure correlates with directly reported product subsidies at r = 0.9994. The governance interaction is the central result. The CAP × WGI term is positive and significant across pooled, event-study, Mundlak, control-function, and no-dummy specifications (δ₃ between +0.008 and +0.018, p < 0.001 in five of six specifications). The stand-alone CAP effect weakens when subsidies are removed from the dependent variable, so we report it as secondary. A latent class model identifies two production technologies. Capital elasticity is positive in both classes, which resolves the negative aggregate capital coefficient. Efficiency rankings shift across specifications (Spearman ρ ≈ 0.4 between pooled and panel estimates), so we treat country rankings as indicative. The marginal CAP effect on inefficiency changes sign near a governance z-score of about 0.87. We interpret all results as conditional associations. They support governance-aware targeting of CAP payments rather than a prescriptive redesign.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察共同农业政策（CAP）支付强度与国家治理质量如何共同塑造农业土地利用的技术效率。样本覆盖27个欧盟成员国，时间范围为2005-2022，共得到486个平衡观测值。我们估计了一个每公顷面板随机前沿模型。每公顷归一化使最大方差膨胀因子从14.98降至3.25。CAP支付强度为每公顷利用农业面积（UAA）隐性补贴的反双曲正弦。该度量与直接报告的产品补贴相关系数为r = 0.9994。治理交互项是核心结果。CAP × WGI项在混合、事件研究、Mundlak、控制函数和无虚拟变量设定中均为正且显著（δ₃介于+0.008与+0.018之间，六种设定中有五种p < 0.001）。当从因变量中剔除补贴后，CAP的独立效应减弱，因此我们将其作为次要结果报告。潜类别模型识别出两种生产技术。资本弹性在两个类别中均为正，这解决了总体资本系数为负的问题。效率排名在不同设定间发生变动（混合估计与面板估计之间的Spearman ρ ≈ 0.4），因此我们将国家排名视为指示性的。CAP对无效率的边际效应在治理z分数约为0.87附近改变符号。我们将所有结果解释为条件关联。这些结果支持对CAP支付进行治理感知的定向投放，而非规定性的重新设计。

articles.title_en: Can property rights delineation incentivize farming households’ consumption? An analysis from the perspective of precautionary savings
articles.title_cn: 产权界定能否激励农户消费？——基于预防性储蓄视角的分析
articles.abstract_en: Property rights system reform is a crucial means to stimulate rural development vitality and facilitate the strategy of rural revitalization. However, there is still insufficient empirical evidence regarding whether property rights delineation can reduce farming households’ precautionary savings and thereby boost their consumption. To address this, this study takes China’s new round of rural land rights confirmation (RLRC) as an example. It constructs a quasi-natural experiment based on data from the 2013 and 2015 China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) and the 2018 China Labor-force Dynamics Survey (CLDS). By comprehensively employing the Difference-in-Differences (DID) method, the Instrumental variable (IV) method, and the Mediation effect model, this study empirically investigates the causal relationship between RLRC and farming households’ consumption, with a particular focus on the mediating effect of precautionary savings. This study finds that the RLRC promotes the growth of farming households’ consumption, and this conclusion remains valid after undergoing various robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that RLRC boosts farming households’ consumption by reducing their precautionary savings, and this mechanism remains robust and effective even after the implementation of the “separation of three rights” reform of rural land and the pilot programs for the mortgage loans of rural land management rights. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that for households with younger household heads and those possessing richer human capital and social capital, the stimulating effect of RLRC on their consumption is more pronounced. Further analysis shows that RLRC primarily promotes subsistence consumption among farming households, rather than developmental consumption, while also having a positive effect on their income improvement. This study not only provides a new explanation for the paradoxical phenomenon of “farming households having money but being reluctant to spend it” but also offers new empirical evidence for government departments to optimize or formulate consumption stimulation policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 产权制度改革是激发农村发展活力、助力乡村振兴战略的重要手段。然而，产权界定能否降低农户预防性储蓄进而促进其消费，仍缺乏充分的经验证据。为此，本研究以中国新一轮农村土地确权（RLRC）为例，基于2013和2015中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）以及2018中国劳动力动态调查（CLDS）数据构建准自然实验，综合运用双重差分法（DID）、工具变量法（IV）和中介效应模型，实证考察RLRC与农户消费之间的因果关系，并重点关注预防性储蓄的中介效应。本研究发现，RLRC促进了农户消费增长，且该结论在经过多种稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析表明，RLRC通过降低农户预防性储蓄来促进其消费，且在农村土地“三权分置”改革和农村土地经营权抵押贷款试点实施后，该机制依然稳健有效。异质性分析表明，对于户主较年轻以及人力资本和社会资本较丰富的农户，RLRC对其消费的促进作用更为明显。进一步分析表明，RLRC主要促进农户的生存型消费而非发展型消费，同时对其收入提升也具有正向作用。本研究不仅为“农户有钱不愿花”的悖论现象提供了新的解释，也为政府部门优化或制定消费刺激政策提供了新的经验证据。

articles.title_en: Analysis of the planning and design strategies for flood resilience and transit-oriented development conducted using the analytic network process
articles.title_cn: 基于网络分析法的防洪韧性与公交导向开发规划设计策略分析
articles.abstract_en: Transit-oriented development (TOD) promotes compact urban form, public-transport accessibility, and reduced automobile dependence, but conventional TOD models insufficiently address the growing flood risks associated with climate change. This study aims to develop an integrated and scenario-sensitive planning framework that reconciles TOD objectives with flood-resilience (FR) requirements in high-density urban environments. An initial set of 17 TOD and FR indicators was identified from the literature. A double-triangle fuzzy Delphi procedure involving experts from academia, government, and industry was used to establish consensus and screen the indicators, after which the analytic network process (ANP) was applied to capture their interdependencies and determine priorities under three decision scenarios. The framework was empirically examined in the Banqiao Station area of New Taipei City, Taiwan, a high-density multimodal TOD area exposed to typhoon-related and urban flood risk. Nine indicators exceeded the consensus threshold of 7.41 and were retained. When TOD and FR were considered simultaneously, rainwater drainage and sewerage facilities received the highest weight (0.16), followed by public transportation accessibility (0.13), permeable surface area (0.12), road area (0.12), and land-use diversity (0.11). When TOD was prioritized, the principal FR interventions were drainage and sewerage facilities (0.32), permeable surfaces (0.27), road area (0.21), and waterproof building design (0.20). When FR was prioritized, the leading TOD factors were public transportation accessibility and land-use diversity (both 0.24), followed by mixed land use (0.19). Theoretically, the study advances TOD research by incorporating climate adaptation directly into an interdependent transport–land-use planning framework. Practically, it provides a scenario-sensitive decision-support approach for coordinating development intensity, transit accessibility, stormwater management, green infrastructure, building adaptation, and emergency access in flood-prone station areas. Theoretically, this study extends conventional TOD thinking by embedding climate adaptation and flood resilience within the interdependent structure of transport–land-use planning rather than treating resilience as an external environmental consideration.
articles.abstract_cn: 公交导向开发（TOD）促进紧凑的城市形态、公共交通可达性并减少汽车依赖，但传统TOD模型未能充分应对与气候变化相关的日益增长的洪水风险。本研究旨在开发一个综合且对情景敏感的规划框架，在高密度城市环境中协调TOD目标与防洪韧性（FR）要求。从文献中识别出初步的17个TOD和FR指标。采用由学术界、政府和产业界专家参与的双三角模糊德尔菲法建立共识并筛选指标，之后应用网络分析法（ANP）捕捉其相互依赖关系并确定三种决策情景下的优先级。该框架在台湾新北市板桥站地区进行了实证检验，该地区是高密度多模式TOD区域，面临台风相关和城市洪水风险。九个指标超过了7.41的共识阈值并被保留。当同时考虑TOD和FR时，雨水排水和污水处理设施获得最高权重（0.16），其次是公共交通可达性（0.13）、透水表面积（0.12）、道路面积（0.12）和土地利用多样性（0.11）。当TOD优先时，主要的FR干预措施为排水和污水处理设施（0.32）、透水面（0.27）、道路面积（0.21）和防水建筑设计（0.20）。当FR优先时，领先的TOD因素为公共交通可达性和土地利用多样性（均为0.24），其次是混合土地利用（0.19）。在理论上，本研究通过将气候适应直接纳入相互依赖的交通—土地利用规划框架，推进了TOD研究。在实践上，它为在洪水易发站区协调开发强度、公交可达性、雨洪管理、绿色基础设施、建筑适应和应急通道提供了一种对情景敏感的决策支持方法。在理论上，本研究通过将气候适应和防洪韧性嵌入交通—土地利用规划的相互依赖结构之中，而非将韧性视为外部环境考量，从而扩展了传统TOD思维。
